## Description

A golden chrysophyte (6–12 µm) with two unequal flagella and a golden-brown chloroplast. Mixotrophic:
it photosynthesises and also eats bacteria and small algae (*Chlorella*), engulfing them one by one;
colonies wider than its mouth escape it.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 6 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A phototactic mixotroph that feeds at the anterior pole with a `mouth_width` (estimated); no published
µmax.

## Literature

- Boraas M.E., Seale D.B., Boxhorn J.E. (1998) Phagotrophy by a flagellate selects for colonial prey:
  a possible origin of multicellularity. Evol. Ecol. 12: 153–164.
